Wall Street Journal :

 Sources: the Trump admin plans to name Nvidia, Amazon, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Anthropic among 24+ AI “national champions” to help them win overseas business   —  The new program is part of an effort to help U.S. AI companies compete for business overseas
